format_notes: GoldenFloat phi-aligned radix-2 float S1E6M9, bias 364. IEEE-style specials at top exponent

catalog.standard: this work; GOLDEN RATIO axis: E_t = round((N-1)/phi^2), a trit is a position; every position spent; E_t/M = 0.6667 against 1/phi = 0.6180
catalog.use_case: phi-derived ternary ladder; huge range at the cost of mantissa

anchor_check.note: 3.0 is not an exact grid point of this format at this width

round_trip_policy: decode: exact bits->f64 (curated_named). encode (reference): round-nearest-ties-even; overflow per format convention. abs_error 0 for representable values.
